records.label: Records
records.description: JSON array of up to 200 objects of field API names to values, e.g. [{"Name": "Acme"}, {"Name": "Globex"}].

all_or_none.description: Roll back every record if any record fails.

create_records_batch.afterResponse:
var composite = (e) => { var t = e.map((o, n) => Object.assign({index: n, id: o.id ?? null, success: o.success}, o.created === undefined ? {} : {created: o.created}, {errors: (o.errors ?? []).map((r) => r.statusCode + ': ' + r.message).join('; ')})); return {results: t, success_count: t.filter((o) => o.success).length, failure_count: t.filter((o) => !o.success).length}; };
return composite(response);
